title: Change your address in Leiden

shortSummary.text: Already registered in the Netherlands? Report your move to the municipality where you will live.

whoThisIsFor.text: Students moving within Leiden or from another Dutch municipality.

whenYouNeedIt.text: Report from four weeks before until five days after moving.

prerequisites.text: Report from four weeks before until five days after moving.

requiredDocuments.text: Housing contract or applicable occupancy evidence. Without DigiD, include signed form and ID copy; cohabitation needs the specified consent and occupant ID copy.

estimatedTime.note: Leiden lists one working day for a move within Leiden, at least three for a move into Leiden. Processing starts from the moving date.

estimatedCost.note: Reporting and processing the address change are free.

numberedSteps.title: Choose the right procedure
numberedSteps.body: First arrival from abroad uses a different route. For a move within the Netherlands, use the new municipality.

numberedSteps.title: Prepare and submit
numberedSteps.body: Use Leiden’s DigiD form or signed paper-form alternative. Attach the required proof of housing.

numberedSteps.title: Check the update
numberedSteps.body: Keep confirmation and check MijnOverheid. Ask separately about local services that may not transfer automatically.

warnings.text: Late reporting can affect the registered moving date.

commonMistakes.text: Do not assume all municipal benefits and services follow the BRP update automatically.

tips.text: Check services and organisations that need a separate update.

faqs.question: Moving to The Hague?
faqs.answer: Report to your new municipality and follow its procedure.

faqs.question: No DigiD?
faqs.answer: Leiden provides a signed form that can be submitted with the required attachments.

faqs.question: Already late?
faqs.answer: Report promptly and check whether you must also contact IND.

emergencyInformation.text: This guide cannot decide your personal case. Use the responsible institution for help.

sections.title: Check before acting
sections.body: For residence-permit holders, late reporting may also require notifying IND directly. Check the official instructions.
